A driver must carry the driver license whenever driving and must sign it for it to be valid. For a driver under twenty-one, the license expires ninety days after the twenty-first birthday, and renewal requires passing an alcohol-awareness test. Physical conditions may lead to license restrictions requiring corrective lenses or special equipment. Alaska will not issue a license while the applicant's driving privilege is suspended, canceled or revoked in Alaska or another state.
